selection_rule: Final model selection reuses the project's existing ranking: primary f1_score (descending), secondary accuracy (descending), then the model name (ascending) as the final tie-break. The optimized candidate is the Phase 6 winner (best_optimized_model) and the baseline candidate is the Phase 4/5 winner (best_baseline_model); both are compared on the hold-out split they were already scored on. When optimization was disabled, skipped or produced no usable winner, the baseline candidate is the final model. No new metric and no new threshold is introduced here.
